sys_hub_action_instance_v2.comment: Connects it to the Xero project and flags it as legacy.
Checks if this Xero project already exists in SPM.
Gets one page of projects from Xero (up to 500)
Looks for an existing US project (Company = Konversational America) with the same name.
Checks again if the project exists in SPM.
Creates or updates the client company from the Xero contact (saved in Customer Account).
Creates or updates the project with Xero data.
Saves the rate model on the project.
Logs “Xero sync failed for project” with the project name.

sys_hub_sub_flow_instance_v2.comment: Connects its tasks to Xero by name. No other data is changed.
Creates or updates the project tasks and rates from Xero.
Gets the rate model for the project currency.

sys_hub_flow_logic_instance_v2.comment: Stops if Xero could not be reached.
Runs all the steps of one project; an error goes to the Catch and the loop continues.
If it does not exist in SPM yet:
Returns the page count to the parent (0 if Xero failed). Also returns the counters of this page. Done e salve.
Error in this project: logs it and continues with the next project.
Keeps the page count returned by Xero - Get Projects.
If one is found:
If it is a legacy project:
Otherwise (new or regular project):
Keeps the tasks created for this project.
Adds 1 to the projects that failed in this page.
Keeps the current Customer Account of the project.
In "only new" mode, skips projects that already exist in SPM.
Calls Xero for the contact only when the project is new, has no Customer Account, or its contact changed in Xero.
Uses the account returned by the Xero contact sync.
Counts only the projects created in this run.
Adds 1 to the created projects.
Adds the tasks created for this project to the total.
Goes to the next Xero project.
Uses the page received from the parent. Page count stays 0 if Xero fails, Resets the counters of this page.
Repeats the steps below for each Xero project.

Checks if this Xero project already exists in SPM.
Connects it to the Xero project and flags it as legacy.
Checks again if the project exists in SPM.
Saves the rate model on the project.
Creates or updates the client company from the Xero contact (saved in Customer Account).

Looks for an existing US project (Company = Konversational America) with the same name.
Logs “Xero sync failed for project” with the project name.

sys_hub_sub_flow_instance_v2.comment: Connects its tasks to Xero by name. No other data is changed.
Creates or updates the project tasks and rates from Xero.
Gets the rate model for the project currency.

sys_hub_flow_logic_instance_v2.comment: Stops if Xero could not be reached.
Uses the page received from the parent. Page count stays 0 if Xero fails, Resets the counters of this page.
Repeats the steps below for each Xero project.
Runs all the steps of one project; an error goes to the Catch and the loop continues.
In "only new" mode, skips projects that already exist in SPM.
Goes to the next Xero project.

If one is found:
If it is a legacy project:
Keeps the current Customer Account of the project.
Calls Xero for the contact only when the project is new, has no Customer Account, or its contact changed in Xero.
Uses the account returned by the Xero contact sync.
Counts only the projects created in this run.
Adds 1 to the created projects.
Keeps the tasks created for this project.
Adds the tasks created for this project to the total.
Adds 1 to the projects that failed in this page.
Keeps the page count returned by Xero - Get Projects.
Otherwise (new or regular project):
